import json, sys, os, subprocess, time

data = json.load(sys.stdin)
payload = data.get("input", "")
if isinstance(payload, str):
    try:
        payload = json.loads(payload)
    except:
        payload = {"filePath": payload.strip()}

file_path = payload.get("filePath", "")
feature_name = payload.get("featureName", "feature")
clean = feature_name.replace(" ", "-").lower()

ts = int(time.time())
repo = r"C:\Users\beine\source\repos\openconclave"
worktree = os.path.join(r"C:\Users\beine\source\repos", f"oc-dev-{ts}")
branch = f"dev/{clean}-{ts}"

DEVNULL = subprocess.DEVNULL
subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "add", worktree, "-b", branch], check=True, cwd=repo, stdout=DEVNULL, stderr=DEVNULL)
subprocess.run(["bun", "install"], cwd=worktree, timeout=180, stdout=DEVNULL, stderr=DEVNULL)

plan = ""
if file_path:
    fp = file_path if os.path.isabs(file_path) else os.path.join(worktree, file_path)
    if os.path.exists(fp):
        with open(fp) as f:
            plan = f.read()

context = {"worktreePath": worktree, "branch": branch, "featureName": feature_name, "planContent": plan, "repoPath": repo}

# Write marker file so all agents and teardown can find the worktree
marker = os.path.join(repo, ".oc-active-worktree.json")
with open(marker, 'w') as mf:
    json.dump({"worktreePath": worktree, "branch": branch, "featureName": feature_name, "repoPath": repo}, mf)

print(json.dumps(context))
